Meet your photographer

Viktoriia
Loskutova.

The photographer behind Vicon Creator. Based in the Netherlands, following stories across the Netherlands and beyond.

My work brings together honest connection and a cinematic eye. I’m drawn to expressive light, natural movement and the small gestures that make a photograph feel personal.

Let’s get to know each other ↗
How I see it

A photograph
should feel
like something.

Beautiful light matters. So does the person standing in it. My approach gives both room: an intentional composition, a little guidance, and enough freedom for something unplanned to happen.

I photograph weddings and couples, individual portraits, maternity, children, families and events. The pace changes with each session, but the attention stays the same. I look for photographs with atmosphere and a clear sense of the people in them.

Editing is part of that vision. Warm colour, considered contrast and expressive black and white help the photographs belong together, while keeping the feeling of the moment.
